recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white photograph of three figures in the foreground against a river and a prominent suspension bridge, topped with bold, two-tone geometric typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures in the foreground create a triangular compositional weight.
The bridge acts as a horizontal anchor in the mid-ground.
The typography at the top balances the heavy dark tones of the figures below.
High-key sky provides a clean backdrop for the header text.
coreInvariants: Extreme contrast between deep blacks and blown-out whites.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to appear as the primary subjects.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central bridge structure provides a stable geometric center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text, drop to the bridge, and then scan the three distinct faces in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of white sky at the top serves as a canvas for the title.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (used for the first word of the title).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones; accent color is highly saturated against the monochrome base.

treatment.fill: Solid (Red for first word, Black for second)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with color-blocking to differentiate words.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the circular 'O' and sharp 'N' geometry perfectly.
Classic geometric choice with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of three people standing by a river with a large suspension bridge in the background. The lighting should be harsh, creating deep black shadows and bright white highlights. Leave the top 20% of the image as pure white negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in all-caps geometric sans-serif (like Avant Garde Bold) at the top. The first word should be red, the second word black. Use very wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the bridge below?
Is the contrast high enough that mid-tones are almost non-existent?

adjustableVariables: Accent color for the first word
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact bridge silhouette to avoid specific landmark copyright if necessary

mustAchieve: Clean negative space at the top

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the red color is vibrant and not muted.
Verify the bridge is sharp and recognizable as a silhouette.
Confirm the figures do not overlap the text area.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast triadic portrait + Geometric Sans header + Color-split typography.
